added: Added Chinese usage guides and interactive demos for nine plugins, linked from the plugin documentation.
changed: Desktop setup now prioritizes Node.js/npm available to the application and lets you select an existing Node.js installation or its bin directory before downloading an environment.
Desktop environment download errors now distinguish connection, timeout, and data-transfer failures and suggest recovery options.
Moved Pi Desk documentation and the local application example from docs/pi-desk/ to docs/.
Diff views now show whitespace-only changes.
features: Project file previews now include Git status in file tabs, line-level change markers, previous/next change navigation, and direct access to the corresponding diff.
fixed: Fixed chat positioning when returning to a conversation or browser tab: reading positions are preserved while a response is running, and the latest exchange is restored after it finishes.
Fixed Escape dismissal of hover cards so their triggers no longer retain keyboard focus.
